reply_text:
I can't set up the daily 09:00 digest. I posted a reply in your DM explaining why.

The short version: scheduled jobs created from this session only save their output locally and don't post to your DM, so the digest wouldn't reach you. I also sent a first message suggesting an admin could set it up, and then corrected that in a follow-up, so you may see both in the DM.

I can still give you a catch-up of #coastal-team whenever you ask, posted to your DM. Your message here didn't ask for one yet, so I haven't read the channel.
